test_seam: Exact literal controller class body compiled natively with Foundation/Observation and local symbolic CaptureBox/AVCaptureDevice/AVCaptureSession bindings. Not a real capture driver or full app execution.
initial_test_correction: Early stop-before-late-capture assertion wrongly forbade necessary stopped-intent cleanup. Preserved as harness history, not an additional product defect. Qualified tests permit it and add latest-denial/failure cleanup cases before product changes.
limits: Fake driver commands do not prove real driver timing or camera-free intervals after every stop
No comprehensive View/Task lifecycle or real interruption acceptance
Center Stage remains separate and unimplemented
No Home, personal data, account, audio, call/message, system alarm/new Live Activities or settings change
